modules.title: 重复触发、发送并核对平台收到的事件

items.title: 在关键位置埋事件
items.text: 在按钮点击、表单提交这类关键动作处写下一行记录代码，命名这次动作。

items.title: 把触发、发送、接收分开核对
items.text: 按钮动作触发事件后，统计 SDK 才会负责发送；在调试视图看到接收记录，是链路核对证据，不表示汇总报表已完成。

items.title: 重复测试并复位状态
items.text: 多点几次确认事件条数随操作变化；清掉测试记录后再操作一次。教学图里的手动发送和接收按钮是模拟控制，不代表每个真实 SDK 都要求人工发送。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 页面示例用手动控制区分触发、发送与接收；真实 SDK 通常按配置发送事件。调试视图能帮助核对测试事件是否到达，不保证所有用户都成功发送，也不等于汇总指标已更新。事件记录说明动作发生，不直接解释用户为什么这样做。

lessonPractice.title: 要统计“立即试用”的点击次数，怎样把埋点从动作核对到平台接收？

options.label: 为按钮配置事件和来源参数，重复点击、发送事件并在调试视图核对收到记录
options.feedback: 对。逐步核对触发、发送和平台接收；重复点击可看次数是否增加，清空示例状态后还能重做验证。

options.label: 只在测试页面时看着按钮点击次数，直接填进正式报表
options.feedback: 人工目测没有形成可核对的事件记录，也不能确认发送和接收链路是否工作。

options.label: 只统计页面打开次数，按页面浏览量推算按钮点击
options.feedback: 页面浏览和按钮点击是不同事件，页面打开次数不能替代点击记录。

en.title: You need the click count for Start trial. How do you check tracking from the action through platform receipt?

options.label: Configure an event and source parameter, click repeatedly, send the events, and verify receipt in a debug view
options.feedback: Correct. Check trigger, send, and receipt separately; repeat clicks to verify the count, then reset and run the check again.

options.label: Count clicks by watching the test page and enter them in the report
options.feedback: Watching does not create verifiable event records or confirm that sending and receipt work.

options.label: Count page views and use them as the button click count
options.feedback: Page views and button clicks are different events; page opens cannot stand in for click records.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请给“立即试用”按钮添加 start_trial 事件和 page_source 参数。验证时重复点击几次，分别核对事件触发、发送和调试视图收到的记录；先清空测试状态再重做一次。说明本地模拟与真实统计 SDK/平台各自做了什么，不要改按钮外观。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add a start_trial event and page_source parameter to the Start trial button. For verification, click it repeatedly and check event trigger, send, and receipt in the debug view separately; reset the test state and run it again. Explain what the local simulation and real analytics SDK/platform each do. Do not change the button's appearance.

references.title: 发送 Google Analytics 事件

learning.assumes: You have seen analytics dashboards, or want to know whether a feature gets used.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish an action trigger, an event send, and platform receipt, then verify counts with repeated actions and a reset.

modules.title: Click once, and how the event record reaches the backend

items.title: Place events at key points
items.text: Write one line of recording code at key actions like button clicks and form submits, naming the action.

items.title: Records are sent when actions happen
items.text: After a click triggers an event, the analytics SDK handles sending; receipt in a debug view is evidence about the test path, not proof that reports are complete.

items.title: Repeat the check, then reset it
items.text: Click several times to see whether records follow the actions, then clear the test state and repeat. The manual send and receipt controls here are teaching simulations, not a claim that real SDKs require manual sending.

modules.title: What it does not tell you
modules.text: The page demo uses manual controls to separate trigger, send, and receipt; real SDKs typically send events according to their configuration. A debug view can help check test events arrived, but does not guarantee every user's event was sent or that aggregate metrics are updated. Event records show actions, not why people took them.

distinctions.label: Conversion funnel
distinctions.text: A funnel is an analysis view built from metrics; tracking is the first step that produces the data—no events, no funnel.

distinctions.label: A/B test
distinctions.text: An A/B test is an experiment method comparing two options; it relies on tracking data to decide which performs better.
